hints.title: Bounded Step Reachability
hints.text: Iterate level by level for k steps, recording all attainable path weights under the threshold t.

hints.title: Layered Transition
hints.text: At each step, advance each path weight along outgoing edges if the cumulative sum remains below t.

hints.title: Deduplicated Aggregation
hints.text: Maintain distinct reachable weights at each node using sets to prevent redundant state propagation.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: k: number of edges in path
complexity.notes: Weights are strictly bounded above by t.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Path DFS encounters exponential permutations of graph cycles.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set deduplication limits state combinations to values below t.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate layered state transitions and enforce the strict threshold.
